contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop and cafe windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The tissue packet is a scene prop, not a product. The navy jacket sleeves are rolled in the editorial; the product shows the full sleeve, conservatively reconstructed, and the back and the pocket interior are inferred. The gray tee is a separate product. The cropped pants show one reflective leg line, and the far leg is inferred. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

copy.titleEn: A PACKET SLIPS FROM THE POCKET

title.en: A packet slips from the pocket
title.de: Ein Päckchen rutscht aus der Tasche

deck.ko: 네이비 지퍼 재킷과 종아리 길이 팬츠.
deck.en: Navy zip layers meet calf-length pants.
deck.de: Marineblaue Ziplagen treffen auf wadenlange Hosen.

intro.ko: 주머니에서 빠지는 티슈 팩을 잡으려 한 걸음 옆으로 움직입니다.
intro.en: She takes a short sidestep to catch a tissue packet slipping from the pocket.
intro.de: Mit einem kurzen Seitenschritt fängt sie ein aus der Tasche rutschendes Taschentuchpäckchen.

body.ko: 네이비 재킷의 긴소매를 올리자 별도 회색 반팔 이너와 손목의 검정 시계가 드러납니다. 검정 크롭 팬츠의 작은 반사선과 재킷 어깨·소매의 흰 선이 플래시에 반응합니다. 아이보리 캡과 회색 양말, 밝은 회색 러닝화가 짙은 착장에 여백을 만듭니다.
body.en: Raised navy jacket sleeves reveal a separate gray tee and black wristwatch. A small reflective mark on the cropped black pants joins white shoulder and sleeve lines in catching direct flash. An ivory cap, gray socks and pale gray runners give the dark outfit lighter edges.
body.de: Hochgeschobene Jackenärmel zeigen ein separates graues Shirt und die schwarze Uhr. Eine kleine Reflexmarkierung an der verkürzten schwarzen Hose fängt wie die weißen Schulter- und Ärmellinien den direkten Blitz. Elfenbeincap, graue Socken und hellgraue Laufschuhe geben dem dunklen Outfit helle Ränder.

pull.en: Short hems leave room for the next step.
pull.de: Kurze Säume lassen Platz für den nächsten Schritt.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Short hems leave room for the next step.

tip.ko: 티슈를 넣은 뒤 주머니 지퍼를 닫고 재킷 커프와 시계를 정리하세요.
tip.en: Zip the pocket after replacing the packet, then reset the jacket cuffs and watch.
tip.de: Nach dem Einstecken den Taschenzip schließen und Jackenbündchen sowie Uhr neu ausrichten.

description.ko: 긴소매와 흰 어깨·소매 반사선, 옆 지퍼 포켓의 재킷입니다.
description.en: Long-sleeved jacket with white shoulder and sleeve reflective lines and side zip pockets.
description.de: Langärmlige Jacke mit weißen Schulter- und Ärmelreflexlinien sowie Seitentaschenzips.

howToWear.ko: 회색 반팔 이너와 분리해 소매만 팔꿈치 아래로 올리세요.
howToWear.en: Push only the jacket sleeves below the elbows, separate from the gray tee.
howToWear.de: Nur die Jackenärmel unter die Ellbogen schieben, getrennt vom grauen Shirt.
